messages:
Jules (Partner Ops): Heads-up: Rigel HW early access program kickoff. Goals: run perf bench, validate telemetry, and align on marketplace listing + joint announcement window. Drop quick status and blockers. :wave:
Alex Chen: NDA finalized and countersigned by Rigel. LegalBot uploaded signed copy to drive: gs://partners/rigel/nda-signed.pdf.
Maria Gonzales: Bench plan proposal: day 0 smoke (sanity tests), day 1-2 perf matrix (p50/p95, token/sec, memory), day 3 long-run stability (24h). Need sample workloads from Rigel.
Samir Patel: Infra notes: images need CUDA 12.1 + cuDNN 9, driver 535.44. We'll stand up an isolated VPC with a bastion and ephemeral user accounts. I'll drop terraform snippets in the repo.
Rigel Eng (partner): We can ship a 2-rack cluster on Apr 20. We'll also provide cluster power/thermal telemetry if you want it pushed to Kinesis. We prefer s3 push for results.
Jules (Partner Ops): Good. Telemetry: redwood core needs model_name, seq_len, latency_ms, error_type, and a sampling_id. Keep PII out. Can you accept Kinesis or do you only support S3?
Rigel Eng (partner): Kinesis is fine. We'll produce a JSON line stream to the provided stream ARN.
Alex Chen: Add fields: kv_cache_hit_rate, batch_size, and is_cached (bool). Example line: {"model":"rw2-7b", "seq_len":128, "latency_ms":35, "kv_cache_hit_rate":0.86, "batch_size":4, "is_cached":true}.
Maria Gonzales: For benchmark harness let's include cold-start (after cache purge), warm-start, and mixed-mode (streaming). Also include a reproducible seed + exact model commit hash.
Samir Patel: Security/egress: we'll lock egress to partner buckets and to our telemetry collector only. Need Rigel to whitelist collector IPs and provide IAM role to write to your Kinesis.
IntegrationsBot: Checklist created: [NDA_signed, infra_provisioned, telemetry_schema_approved, data_flow_whitelist, bench_results_bucket, safety_runbook, announcement_embargo_date].
Jules (Partner Ops): Announcement/marketplace notes: marketing wants a 2-week embargo after bench completion for joint press. Proposed embargo end: May 10. We need a draft co-announcement by May 3. Who can own that?
Alex Chen: I can supply technical blurb + perf highlights once benches finish. We'll avoid publishing raw numbers until both sides sign off.
Rigel Eng (partner): Marketing will provide logo assets and an AMS seller account for the marketplace listing. We need the integration SKU + brief doc.
Samir Patel: Hardware safety: last time one node tripped due to thermal spike. I'll author a short runbook with shutdown thresholds, contact ops list, and a quick power-cycling checklist.
Maria Gonzales: On metrics: set alert for p95 latency > 3x baseline and for memory growth > 10% over 6h. Also log GC/oom events.
Jules (Partner Ops): Action items: Alex owns bench harness + results upload. Maria owns telemetry schema + alerts. Samir owns infra + safety runbook. Rigel to provide assets, cluster availability, and IAM/Kinesis details. I'll schedule a 30m prep on Apr 17.
LegalBot: Note: NDA restricts public disclosure until both parties approve. Please route any announcement drafts through Legal.
Rigel Eng (partner): All clear. We'll target cluster delivery Apr 20 and provide ops contact. Thanks everyone.
Jules (Partner Ops): Perfect. I'll update the drive with timelines and add the marketplace onboarding checklist. :rocket:
